bacterial_blight.display_name: Cotton Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot
bacterial_blight.symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots restricted by leaf veins, turning brown or black; black lesions on petioles and stems ('black arm').

organic_measures.name: Copper Oxychloride + Pseudomonas fluorescens
organic_measures.method: Spray Copper Oxychloride (2.5 g/L) alternated with Pseudomonas fluorescens (5 ml/L).

organic_measures.name: Acid Delinting of Cotton Seed (Pre-planting)
organic_measures.method: Treat fuzzy cotton seeds with concentrated sulfuric acid (100 ml/kg) to eliminate seed coat bacterial contamination.

chemical_measures.name: Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride
chemical_measures.active_ingredient: Streptocycline 1 g/10 L + COC 50 WP 2.5 g/L
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply during morning or evening.

prevention_measures: Use certified acid-delinted and treated seeds.
Remove and burn previous cotton crop stalks (stubble destruction).
sources: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) Nagpur

curl_virus.pathogen: Cotton leaf curl virus (Begomovirus, vectored by Whitefly)
curl_virus.symptoms: Upward or downward leaf curling, vein thickening and enation (leaf-like outgrowths on vein undersides), severe plant stunting.

organic_measures.name: Yellow Sticky Traps & Whitefly Repellent
organic_measures.method: Install yellow sticky traps (15 per acre). Spray neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) or neem oil (5 ml/L).

organic_measures.name: Border Cropping with Sorghum / Maize
organic_measures.method: Plant 2-3 rows of tall sorghum, bajra, or maize as a physical barrier against flying whitefly migration.

chemical_measures.name: Diafenthiuron 50% WP or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC (Vector management)
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Target lower leaf surface where nymphs reside. Avoid spraying during honeybee activity.

prevention_measures: Sow recommended CLCuV-tolerant / resistant Bt cotton hybrids.
Eradicate weed hosts (e.g., Parthenium, Xanthium, Sida, Abutilon) around fields.
Complete timely sowing before peak whitefly breeding season.
sources: ICAR-CICR Cotton Leaf Curl Virus Advisory

fusarium_wilt.pathogen: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum (Soil-borne Fungal)
fusarium_wilt.symptoms: Yellowing and browning along leaf margins, wilting, leaf drop from base upwards, and dark brown discoloration of vascular vascular rings inside the stem.

organic_measures.name: Trichoderma viride Soil Enrichment
organic_measures.method: Apply Trichoderma viride enriched farmyard manure (2.5 kg Trichoderma in 100 kg FYM per acre).

chemical_measures.name: Carbendazim 50% WP (Soil drenching)
chemical_measures.dosage: 1.0 g per liter for collar drenching
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply around root zone of early symptomatic plants.

prevention_measures: Practice long-term crop rotation with non-host crops like sorghum, maize, or paddy.
Avoid moving contaminated soil or implements from infested to clean fields.
Ensure field drainage to reduce root stress.

cotton_healthy.symptoms: Broad green leaves, normal squaring and boll formation, upright growth.

organic_measures.name: Balanced Micronutrient (Magnesium / Zinc) Spray
organic_measures.method: Foliar spray of 1% Magnesium Sulphate during boll development.

prevention_measures: Maintain regular scouting for early bollworm or sucking pests.
